title: Example: Skagensmalernes Artistic Style
description: This profile captures the visual and emotional dimensions found in the Danish Skagen painters' style: natural light, realism in everyday life, coastal settings, and a subtle interplay between people and nature.

latent_dimensions.name: Light Atmosphere
latent_dimensions.explanation: The soft, coastal light characteristic of Skagen's natural setting
latent_dimensions.example_value: A hazy yellow-pink hue falling across beach sand at dusk

latent_dimensions.name: Brushstroke Texture
latent_dimensions.explanation: How visible and expressive the brushstrokes are
latent_dimensions.example_value: Soft visible strokes capturing light wind in garments

latent_dimensions.name: Social Intimacy
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much interpersonal closeness or everyday life is depicted
latent_dimensions.example_value: Two women sewing in silence near a sunlit window

latent_dimensions.name: Color Palette Temperature
latent_dimensions.explanation: Balance between cool coastal blues and warm sun tones
latent_dimensions.example_value: Muted beige with hints of seafoam blue and pale ochre

latent_dimensions.name: Scene Stillness
latent_dimensions.explanation: How tranquil and motionless the scene feels
latent_dimensions.example_value: A woman seated at a table lost in thought as time slows

latent_dimensions.name: Environmental Dominance
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much the setting (coast, sky, light) dominates over human figures
latent_dimensions.example_value: Small figures walking against a vast shoreline under open sky

latent_dimensions.name: Narrative Clarity
latent_dimensions.explanation: How strongly a story or moment is implied in the composition
latent_dimensions.example_value: A man staring out at the sea while children play behind him

latent_dimensions.name: Mood in Picture
latent_dimensions.explanation: The emotional atmosphere conveyed by the scene
latent_dimensions.example_value: A lonely figure gazing out into the twilight sea

latent_dimensions.name: Emotional Temperature
latent_dimensions.explanation: Emotional warmth or coolness conveyed by facial expressions and setting
latent_dimensions.example_value: A family gathered quietly under a golden evening sky

latent_dimensions.name: Cultural Timelessness
latent_dimensions.explanation: How anchored the scene is in a specific historical period
latent_dimensions.example_value: Clothing and furnishings typical of late 1800s Skagen life

latent_dimensions.name: Color Intensity
latent_dimensions.explanation: How vibrant or muted the color saturation is
latent_dimensions.example_value: Faded ochre and soft blue-greys blending with natural linen

latent_dimensions.name: Perspective Depth
latent_dimensions.explanation: The amount of spatial depth and perspective in the image
latent_dimensions.example_value: Figures receding softly into the dune landscape

latent_dimensions.name: Scene Time of Painting
latent_dimensions.explanation: When the scene appears to take place historically
latent_dimensions.example_value: Fishermen with 19th-century attire walking the beach

latent_dimensions.name: Image Frame Style
latent_dimensions.explanation: What type of frame would traditionally surround the image
latent_dimensions.example_value: A dark oak hand-carved frame with slight gilded edges

latent_dimensions.name: Subject Focus
latent_dimensions.explanation: Whether the emphasis is on landscape, people, or objects
latent_dimensions.example_value: Children playing on the beach under open sky

latent_dimensions.name: Figure Detail Level
latent_dimensions.explanation: Degree of anatomical or facial detail rendered in the figures
latent_dimensions.example_value: Smooth outlines and soft shadows defining forms

latent_dimensions.name: Clothing Style
latent_dimensions.explanation: The type and period of clothing depicted
latent_dimensions.example_value: Aprons, long skirts, work shirts and fishermen’s garments

latent_dimensions.name: Canvas Surface Perception
latent_dimensions.explanation: How the texture of the canvas or medium is perceived
latent_dimensions.example_value: Barely visible cross-weave texture under thin paint

latent_dimensions.name: Background Activity
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much narrative or motion is present in the background
latent_dimensions.example_value: Figures moving faintly in distant fields or beach scenes

dimensions.title: Example of doing Photoshop sort of styling

latent_dimensions.name: Color Temperature
latent_dimensions.explanation: Controls the warmth or coolness of the image tones
latent_dimensions.example_value: #87CEEB sky with moderate green vegetation

latent_dimensions.name: Contrast Level
latent_dimensions.explanation: Degree of tonal separation between light and dark areas
latent_dimensions.example_value: Clear shadow from the man on pebbles, yet details visible

latent_dimensions.name: Scene Realism
latent_dimensions.explanation: Degree to which the image mimics real-world lighting and texture
latent_dimensions.example_value: Shoreline textures and foliage appear true-to-life

latent_dimensions.name: Framing Balance
latent_dimensions.explanation: Symmetry and weight distribution in the composition
latent_dimensions.example_value: Coastline guiding eye diagonally, figure offset to the right

latent_dimensions.name: Light Source Clarity
latent_dimensions.explanation: How defined and directional the light source appears
latent_dimensions.example_value: Sunlight casting gentle, soft-edged shadows

latent_dimensions.name: Grain Texture
latent_dimensions.explanation: The visibility and strength of image texture or photographic grain
latent_dimensions.example_value: Subtle grain visible in beach stones and cliff face

latent_dimensions.name: Color Saturation
latent_dimensions.explanation: Intensity of the colors used in the image
latent_dimensions.example_value: Lush greens, deep blue sea, but not oversaturated

latent_dimensions.name: Depth Perception
latent_dimensions.explanation: The sense of distance and spatial layering in the image
latent_dimensions.example_value: Foreground pebbles and distant sea line clearly separated

latent_dimensions.name: Movement Suggestion
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much implied motion is present in the image
latent_dimensions.example_value: Gentle waves, walking posture of man

latent_dimensions.name: Nature Dominance
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much of the image is occupied by natural elements
latent_dimensions.example_value: Sea, cliffs, and vegetation make up majority of frame

latent_dimensions.name: Human Presence Subtlety
latent_dimensions.explanation: How prominent or intrusive the human figure appears
latent_dimensions.example_value: Single person placed low and off to the side

latent_dimensions.name: Horizon Line Prominence
latent_dimensions.explanation: Visibility and compositional dominance of the horizon
latent_dimensions.example_value: Soft line where sky meets sea in top third of image

latent_dimensions.name: Ambient Light Mood
latent_dimensions.explanation: Overall feeling of lighting across the scene
latent_dimensions.example_value: Bright daylight with soft contrast

latent_dimensions.name: Visual Simplicity
latent_dimensions.explanation: How minimal or cluttered the visual composition appears
latent_dimensions.example_value: Clean lines, few objects, no visual noise

latent_dimensions.name: Detail Sharpness
latent_dimensions.explanation: Crispness and definition of image details
latent_dimensions.example_value: Edges of rocks and cliff vegetation clearly visible

latent_dimensions.name: Foreground Emphasis
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much visual weight is given to the closest part of the image
latent_dimensions.example_value: Rocks and man provide anchoring without dominating

latent_dimensions.name: Color Palette Harmony
latent_dimensions.explanation: How well the colors blend and complement each other
latent_dimensions.example_value: Earthy browns, greens, and cool blue sea tones

latent_dimensions.name: Line Flow
latent_dimensions.explanation: How the visual lines guide the viewer's eye
latent_dimensions.example_value: Curved coastline draws eye from figure to horizon

latent_dimensions.name: Narrative Suggestion
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much the image implies a story or human experience
latent_dimensions.example_value: Elderly man walking with poles along coastal path

latent_dimensions.name: Temporal Atmosphere
latent_dimensions.explanation: Time of day and temporal mood (pastoral, timeless, fleeting)
latent_dimensions.example_value: Midday sun with no nostalgic or futuristic cues

title: Example: A company Corporate Language
description: This profile captures the tone, style, and communication dimensions typical of a company's corporate language: professional, innovative, collaborative, and tech-forward, yet human and inviting.

latent_dimensions.name: Emotional Tone
latent_dimensions.explanation: The overall emotional resonance conveyed through the language
latent_dimensions.example_value: At Trifork, we believe in building a smarter tomorrow together.

latent_dimensions.name: Formality Level
latent_dimensions.explanation: The degree of formal vs. informal language used
latent_dimensions.example_value: We invite you to join our journey of innovation.

latent_dimensions.name: Call-to-Action Strength
latent_dimensions.explanation: The urgency and directness of action-oriented language
latent_dimensions.example_value: Discover how you can be part of shaping the future with us.

latent_dimensions.name: Technical Depth
latent_dimensions.explanation: The amount of technical detail and specificity present
latent_dimensions.example_value: Leveraging cloud-native architectures and AI-driven solutions.

latent_dimensions.name: Environmental Urgency
latent_dimensions.explanation: How urgent or critical the environmental problem is presented
latent_dimensions.example_value: Sustainable digital transformation is essential for lasting impact.

latent_dimensions.name: Narrative Structure
latent_dimensions.explanation: How strongly the text follows a chronological or story-based structure
latent_dimensions.example_value: From ideation to implementation, we partner with you every step of the way.

latent_dimensions.name: Hopefulness Level
latent_dimensions.explanation: The degree to which the language conveys hope for change
latent_dimensions.example_value: Together, we can create meaningful change through technology.

latent_dimensions.name: Clarity of Problem Definition
latent_dimensions.explanation: How explicitly the problem is introduced and explained
latent_dimensions.example_value: Organizations face increasing complexity in digital transformation.

latent_dimensions.name: Tone of Optimism vs Realism
latent_dimensions.explanation: Balance between hopeful language and realistic descriptions
latent_dimensions.example_value: While challenges are real, we see opportunities for growth and innovation.

latent_dimensions.name: Use of Jargon
latent_dimensions.explanation: Degree of domain-specific terminology used
latent_dimensions.example_value: Microservices, Kubernetes, machine learning.

latent_dimensions.name: Engagement Style
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much the reader is actively engaged through direct address
latent_dimensions.example_value: Let’s collaborate to unlock your organization’s potential.

latent_dimensions.name: Innovation Framing
latent_dimensions.explanation: How strongly the text positions the solution as innovative or cutting-edge
latent_dimensions.example_value: Pioneering next-generation solutions for tomorrow’s challenges.

latent_dimensions.name: Marketing Tone
latent_dimensions.explanation: Level of branding and promotional language present
latent_dimensions.example_value: Empowering your business with cutting-edge technology.

latent_dimensions.name: Scientific Anchoring
latent_dimensions.explanation: Presence of data, facts, or scientific references
latent_dimensions.example_value: Our solutions are validated by industry-leading benchmarks.

latent_dimensions.name: Problem-to-Solution Clarity
latent_dimensions.explanation: How clearly the text presents the relationship between the problem and the solution
latent_dimensions.example_value: That’s why Trifork delivers end-to-end digital solutions.

latent_dimensions.name: Use of Timeline
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much chronological structure is used to show progress or process
latent_dimensions.example_value: 2024: Launch. 2025: Scale. 2026: Transform.

latent_dimensions.name: Community Appeal
latent_dimensions.explanation: How much the text aims to rally collective effort or shared responsibility
latent_dimensions.example_value: Join our community of innovators and thought leaders.

latent_dimensions.name: Visual Language Use
latent_dimensions.explanation: Degree to which the language creates mental imagery
latent_dimensions.example_value: Imagine a seamless digital experience, from first click to final delivery.

latent_dimensions.name: Readability Level
latent_dimensions.explanation: How easily the text can be read and understood by the general audience
latent_dimensions.example_value: We make complex technology simple and accessible.

latent_dimensions.name: Inspirational Drive
latent_dimensions.explanation: The extent to which the text seeks to inspire action or emotion
latent_dimensions.example_value: Let’s build a brighter digital future together.
